experiences.name: Evening Seafood Dinner at Mikrolimano Harbor
experiences.description: Dine at a traditional waterfront taverna in Mikrolimano, Piraeus, sampling fresh grilled octopus, sea bream, and local mezedes paired with ouzo. The harbor setting is magical in the evening breeze, avoiding midday heat while staying close to Athens accommodation hubs.

experiences.name: Indoor Athens Central Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the historic Varvakios Agora (Athens Central Market), an indoor covered market where you can taste local cheeses, olives, cured meats, honey, and spices with a guided food tour. Perfectly sheltered from heat or rain, and centrally located near most Athens hotels.

experiences.name: Sunset Swimming at Vouliagmeni Beach
experiences.description: Visit the upscale organized beach of Vouliagmeni in the late afternoon and evening when temperatures drop. Enjoy crystal-clear waters, sunbeds, and a beach bar atmosphere. Easily accessible from central Athens by coastal tram, making it a convenient beach escape without long travel.

experiences.name: Evening Cooking Class: Traditional Greek Cuisine
experiences.description: Join a small-group indoor evening cooking class in the Psiri neighborhood, learning to prepare classic dishes like moussaka, spanakopita, and tzatziki from scratch using local market ingredients. A cool, hands-on cultural experience that avoids the daytime heat entirely.

experiences.name: Late Afternoon Snorkeling at Navagio Beach Area
experiences.description: Take a short boat excursion from Zakynthos port in the late afternoon to snorkel in the turquoise waters near the famous Shipwreck Beach cove. The light is golden, temperatures are cooler, and the crowds have thinned. Boat tours depart from the nearby port, keeping travel time minimal.
